content.short: Littio is a Colombian app for USD and EUR digital dollar accounts, yield and a Mastercard for spending.
content.description: Littio is a Colombian fintech that gives Latin Americans access to US dollar and euro accounts along with dollar-denominated yield. Users get global accounts in USD, EUR and Colombian pesos, a Mastercard for international spending and ATM withdrawals, and yield products paying up to around 9.8 percent through its Bolsillos and Bovedas features. Under the hood, Littio uses the USDC and EURC stablecoins issued by Circle for settlement and storage, while integrating with local banks so users can top up and withdraw in their home currency. It targets freelancers, remote workers and travelers who want to save in hard currency and earn yield despite local inflation.
content.meta: Littio gives LatAm users USD/EUR accounts, dollar yield and a Mastercard. Discover Littio and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
